scope: Local production build; no deployment or search-engine indexing verification
notes: English-body equality catches missing translations, but is not a full linguistic quality evaluation.
Text-only articles retain the site social card; no invented article illustration or author is added to structured data.
Titles/descriptions have no hard character cutoff; their lengths are recorded for editorial review.
HTML es-419 remains valid BCP 47; hreflang uses es-ES for Spain and es for the Latin American/general Spanish edition.
Indexing, search rankings, Search Console and Core Web Vitals are outside this local audit.
